description: This Java class defines an immutable data transfer object for handling bulk transfer of loan officers within the Fineract organization module. It provides static factory methods for creating template instances used in transfer screens, encapsulating details like office, loan officer IDs, assignment dates, and options for selection.

classes.name: BulkTransferLoanOfficerData
classes.description: Immutable data object returned for loan-officer bulk transfer screens, encapsulating transfer details and options.

methods.name: templateForBulk
methods.description: Factory method to create a comprehensive template instance with all options and details for bulk transfer.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Factory method to create a simplified template instance with basic transfer info.

methods.name: BulkTransferLoanOfficerData
methods.description: Private constructor initializing all final fields for the data object.
